d3134169f35b072016ea2be520b68a94.pythonCode:
import math

import pandas as pd


CATEGORY_RESULT_ID = "c0108509b7116e3bf91c6e94ee73d21e"
PRIOR_YEAR = 2002
CURRENT_YEAR = 2003


def optional_ratio(numerator, denominator, multiplier=100):
    if denominator is None or abs(denominator) < 1e-12:
        return None
    return numerator / denominator * multiplier


raw = pd.DataFrame(datasets[CATEGORY_RESULT_ID])

prior = (
    raw.loc[raw["sales_year"] == PRIOR_YEAR, ["product_category", "net_sales"]]
    .rename(columns={"net_sales": "prior_net_sales"})
)
current = (
    raw.loc[raw["sales_year"] == CURRENT_YEAR, ["product_category", "net_sales"]]
    .rename(columns={"net_sales": "current_net_sales"})
)

categories = sorted(set(prior["product_category"]).union(current["product_category"]))
result_frame = pd.DataFrame({"product_category": categories})
result_frame = result_frame.merge(prior, on="product_category", how="left")
result_frame = result_frame.merge(current, on="product_category", how="left")
result_frame["prior_net_sales"] = result_frame["prior_net_sales"].fillna(0.0)
result_frame["current_net_sales"] = result_frame["current_net_sales"].fillna(0.0)

result_frame["change_amount"] = (
    result_frame["current_net_sales"] - result_frame["prior_net_sales"]
)

total_prior = float(result_frame["prior_net_sales"].sum())
total_current = float(result_frame["current_net_sales"].sum())
total_change = total_current - total_prior

result_frame["yoy_pct"] = result_frame.apply(
    lambda row: optional_ratio(
        row["change_amount"],
        row["prior_net_sales"],
    ),
    axis=1,
)
result_frame["contribution_amount"] = result_frame["change_amount"]
result_frame["contribution_rate_pct"] = result_frame.apply(
    lambda row: optional_ratio(
        row["change_amount"],
        total_change,
    ),
    axis=1,
)
result_frame["prior_share_pct"] = result_frame.apply(
    lambda row: optional_ratio(
        row["prior_net_sales"],
        total_prior,
    ),
    axis=1,
)
result_frame["current_share_pct"] = result_frame.apply(
    lambda row: optional_ratio(
        row["current_net_sales"],
        total_current,
    ),
    axis=1,
)

result_frame["prior_year"] = PRIOR_YEAR
result_frame["current_year"] = CURRENT_YEAR
result_frame["total_prior_net_sales"] = total_prior
result_frame["total_current_net_sales"] = total_current
result_frame["total_change_amount"] = total_change
result_frame["total_yoy_pct"] = optional_ratio(total_change, total_prior)

output_columns = [
    "product_category",
    "prior_year",
    "current_year",
    "prior_net_sales",
    "current_net_sales",
    "change_amount",
    "yoy_pct",
    "contribution_amount",
    "contribution_rate_pct",
    "prior_share_pct",
    "current_share_pct",
    "total_prior_net_sales",
    "total_current_net_sales",
    "total_change_amount",
    "total_yoy_pct",
]

result_frame = (
    result_frame[output_columns]
    .sort_values("current_net_sales", ascending=False)
    .reset_index(drop=True)
)

rounding = {
    "prior_net_sales": 2,
    "current_net_sales": 2,
    "change_amount": 2,
    "yoy_pct": 2,
    "contribution_amount": 2,
    "contribution_rate_pct": 2,
    "prior_share_pct": 2,
    "current_share_pct": 2,
    "total_prior_net_sales": 2,
    "total_current_net_sales": 2,
    "total_change_amount": 2,
    "total_yoy_pct": 2,
}
for column, places in rounding.items():
    result_frame[column] = result_frame[column].map(
        lambda value: None if value is None or (
            isinstance(value, float) and math.isnan(value)
        ) else round(float(value), places)
    )

result = result_frame.to_dict(orient="records")
columns = output_columns

ecaf61ccf0b4dbcfbd3a364e43e92148.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(d.detail_line_total, 0) - h.SubTotal) > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subtotal_mismatch_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.detail_line_total, 0) - h.SubTotal < -0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detail_sum_below_subtotal_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(d.detail_line_total, 0) - h.SubTotal > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS detail_sum_above_subtotal_orders, SUM(d.detail_line_total) AS detail_net_sales, SUM(h.SubTotal) AS header_subtotal, SUM(d.detail_line_total) - SUM(h.SubTotal) AS total_difference, MAX(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(d.detail_line_total, 0) - h.SubTotal) > 0.01 THEN ABS(COALESCE(d.detail_line_total, 0) - h.SubTotal) ELSE 0 END) AS max_subtotal_abs_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(h.TotalDue - (h.SubTotal + h.TaxAmt + h.Freight)) > 0.01 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_due_mismatch_orders, MAX(CASE WHEN ABS(h.TotalDue - (h.SubTotal + h.TaxAmt + h.Freight)) > 0.01 THEN ABS(h.TotalDue - (h.SubTotal + h.TaxAmt + h.Freight)) ELSE 0 END) AS max_total_due_abs_diff FROM salesorderheader AS h LEFT JOIN (SELECT SalesOrderID, SUM(LineTotal) AS detail_line_total FROM salesorderdetail GROUP BY SalesOrderID) AS d ON d.SalesOrderID = h.SalesOrderID WHERE h.OrderDate >= '2002-01-01' AND h.OrderDate < '2004-01-01'
